The controlling design’s continuous-time interfaces govern the page requirements; the Brownian Itô page was omitted from the batch manifest because its Brownian-integrator construction is unused and cannot replace the local proof. The full-run dependency check still reports empty scaffolds and stale levels in other batches; the exact page and item IDs are recorded in the notes.
